purpose: Evaluate creator-supplied H3 videos as motion references, distinguishing source quality, recovery, body adaptation and game-export readiness.
environment: Separate G-drive Python environment and caches. Existing MotionBricks and GEM-X environments retained.

tests.k0_control: Known native Pounce, 3.2s plus0.8s hold, 120frames at30Hz, known front/side cameras and retained joint ground truth.
tests.k0_h3: Full294frame H3 pounce at24Hz; available K0 body, approximate camera. Character reader trained on native synthetic imagery. This camera/domain change is explicitly a stress test.
tests.k0_contact_ablation: Reuse exactly the same joint readings with steps=false and foot_lock=false. Both root-from-steps and locking are disabled together; this does not isolate either one alone.
tests.k0_smoothing_ablation: Reuse joint readings with lowpass_slow_hz=3. Other fit settings unchanged; downstream contact/root effects can still differ.
tests.concept_human_recovery: Existing GEM-X human estimator applied to a stylized robot. No exact matching concept-body rig is available. Raw skeleton and source overlay retained.
tests.concept_c08_adapter: Existing direct SOMA-to-C08 adapter applied unchanged. Whole-avatar grounding and rest hands are documented, not presented as learned motion or physical contact.
tests.c07_control: Published C07 native Pounce rendered through known cameras. Separate ground truth and recovery evaluation.
tests.c07_h3: Available published C07 differs visibly from H3 frame0. Bounded training/recovery only; failure cannot isolate solver quality from input-body mismatch.
tests.k0_camera_specific: 1000 synthetic poses through the estimated H3 camera,2000 additional steps, fresh checkpoint initialized from base K0. No H3 video frames used for training; baseline preserved.
tests.k0_estimated_camera_locked: Same camera-specific joint readings, masks and timing, but unit camera correction instead of automatic scale2.438/offset/rotation. Camera remains manually estimated, not ground truth.

checks: Train/held-out synthetic joint error is separate from known-motion recovery error.
Compare known-control world-joint positions and rotation errors without per-frame alignment; state any static alignment separately.
Retain native translations unsupported by the rotation-only fitter as a representability baseline.
Inspect original and recovered animations from source and novel cameras.
Validate finite poses, fixed rig lengths, timing, exported-rig forward kinematics and glTF structure.
Measure end-to-start root displacement separately from return-to-stance appearance.
Treat reprojection, contact heuristics and export validity as diagnostics, not physical-balance or visual-acceptance proofs.
Save every comment/score per test/body/version, and export all review history together.
publication: Only selected generated robot previews, original creator rigs/recovered outputs and sanitized reports. No private human footage, training renders, trained reader weights, third-party inference weights or credentials.
limitations: No new H3 generation, paid service or commercial license activated. A completed test is computed and available for review, not accepted for production. MotionBricks is not used to generate the Video2Rig/GEM-X recovery outputs.
outcome: 13 completed comparisons, not13 distinct new motions. Both no-contact ablations are exact no-effect controls; H3 fits retain serious quality problems. See catalog and per-test reports.
